You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hi, Jamal Carter, 3/14/95. Can you transfer my albuterol and sertraline from Brightway number 4471 in Columbus to the Harbor on Main in Lakeview?
AGENT: I'll verify your identity first, then help with those transfers. Great, Jamal. I can help with that. Let me find the Harbor store on Main in Lakeview to confirm the right location. I'm not finding a Harbor store on Main in Lakeview. Can you give me the store ID or the full address so I can make sure I'm transferring to the right location?  [system actions: verify_identity, find_stores]
CALLER: Uh, I don't have the ID. It's the one by my apartment, near Oak.
AGENT: Let me search for that. Perfect, that's Harbor Pharmacy Main St University at 2250 Main Street in Lakeview, near Oak. Is that the one?  [system actions: find_stores]
CALLER: Yeah, near Oak. That's the one.
AGENT: Great. Now let me pull up your prescriptions at Brightway to get the details for the albuterol and sertraline. I'm not seeing any prescriptions in our system for you. Those medications are at Brightway, which is a different pharmacy chain. To transfer them to Harbor, Brightway will need to send them to us, or we can request them from Brightway. Do you want me to request the transfer from our end?  [system actions: list_prescriptions]
CALLER: I don't know the address, I just moved. Can't you just tell me which ones there are?
AGENT: I understand, but I can only see prescriptions that are already in the Harbor system. Since your albuterol and sertraline are at Brightway right now, I don't have access to their records. You'd need to either call Brightway to get those details, or ask them to transfer the prescriptions to Harbor. Once they send them over, I can help you from there.
CALLER: Okay yeah, just go ahead and request it from Brightway then, from your end. Number 4471.
AGENT: I can request the transfer, but I need the prescription IDs or at least the drug names and strengths to send the request to Brightway. Do you know the strength of your albuterol inhaler and your sertraline dose?
CALLER: I don't know the exact strengths off the top of my head, just albuterol inhaler and sertraline. Can't you look it up with my name and birthday on your end?
AGENT (LATEST): I wish I could, but since those prescriptions are at Brightway, they're not in our system yet—I can only see what's already here at Harbor. You'll need to contact Brightway directly with your name and date of birth, and ask them to transfer the albuterol inhaler and sertraline to Harbor Pharmacy Main St University in Lakeview. They'll have all the strength details and can send them right over.

CONDITIONS:
stop_0: Agent confirms both transfers to H-302 with its address.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.
